accepted_decisions.semantics: Terminal member, operation-kind, record-type, and property symbols are absolute IRIs. Graph record IDs remain strings.
Terminal facts assemble across one complete atomic PopulationPlan. This slice has one invocation per plan and does not exercise property-only add-ons.
Every reference to a record created in the same plan requires an explicit DependsOn fact, including each relation endpoint.
Unordered multivalued slots canonicalize as semantic sets while retaining every derivation path; ordered slots preserve contract-declared order. This slice has no multivalued input.
The offline fixture corpus is the primary gate. A separate pinned Lutra differential gate becomes required only after its complete tool lock exists.

fact_order: Record before Property before RelationSource before RelationTarget before DependsOn
remaining fields as canonical JSON ascending

ontology_symbol_binding.rule: Every terminal type and property IRI must resolve bijectively to one ontology-registry local symbol. Schema IDs and prefixes are not implicit symbol identities.
ontology_symbol_binding.temporary_boundary: Required until the contract-kernel SymbolIdentityPolicy is implemented.

lineage_identity.expansion_path_order: the same canonical semantic emission order; duplicate semantic calls are tie-broken by canonical call payload and multiplicity ordinal
lineage_identity.source_pattern_index: evidence only; excluded from semantic emission and expansion-path identity

source-bytes-sha256-v1.encoding: bytes as stored; no newline or Unicode normalization

canonical-json-sha256-v1.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; object keys sorted; separators ',' and ':'; ensure_ascii=false; finite JSON numbers only; no Unicode normalization

logical_contract.rule: Use the complete values emitted by LogicalGraphContract.identity_payload(). The descriptive contract_id is not part of semantic identity.

effective_recipe.rule: Bind the selected root, the complete closed terminal signatures, and every canonical template sorted by template IRI. Alpha-normalize variables and sort semantic patterns. Exact source bytes, source locators, source digests, and lock metadata remain separate execution-input identities.

invocation.rule: Encode complete typed arguments in the selected root template's parameter order.

plan.rule: schema_version is graph-recipe-plan-v0; sort invocation digests; include the complete member-graph and proposed-operations artifacts.

candidate.rule: Use the existing CandidateSubgraph digest payload and preserve proposed write order.

red_test_obligation.required_behavior: The conformance runner must fail every case whose required semantic digest is pending, generate reviewed candidate values only through an explicit propose-golden action, and never substitute a sentinel or fabricated digest.

excluded_scope: Lutra execution before a complete tool lock
backend selection beyond the existing in-memory graph
